thread:
Aisha B.: Heads up — NorthPeak legal wants our final pricing today. They're asking for 12mo commit, $25k/mo, net60, and a 30% cap on overage spend for first 6mo. Need Deal Desk approval to proceed. Details below.

Connor G.: Can you confirm ARR impact and whether this needs a finance sign-off? Also is this a strategic partner discount or a one-off?

Aisha B.: It's a strategic partner pilot. Revenue delta vs list is ~28% discount in year1. We expect $300k ARR year1 with commit. The cap shifts overage revenue recognition — see calc.

Priya S.: Quick calc: commit $300k, discounted list value $416k => discount ~28%. If they bust the cap, we still recognize up to cap; worst-case revenue loss ~ $40k. Approving if legal ok and commit can't be shortened.

Connor G.: Ok, finance tentatively ok. Need to document that discount is conditional on 12mo non-cancellable commit. Also require PO + legal sign-off. I'll approve from finance once legal confirms.

Jorge M.: tagging @billing-bot for bill-run impact & invoice template. Also will need a one-off SKU for 'NorthPeak pilot credit'.

billing-bot: Automated check: No existing credits for this account. Suggested invoice schedule: monthly commit invoices in advance, overage to be invoiced monthly. Flagged: Net60 extends DSO; recommend collection hold if >90 days past due.

Aisha B.: Here's proposed clause to put in SOW:
```
Commit: $25,000/month for 12 months (non-cancellable). Overage cap: Customer billed up to 130% of commit at agreed rate for months 1–6; thereafter standard rate. Payment terms: Net60.
```

Priya S.: Fine with that language. Finance approves on the condition we get PO + legal clause added. Please log this approval in Deal Desk (deal-id NP-0526).

Connor G.: Approving finance side now. @Jorge M. once legal confirms, consider this approved. :white_check_mark:

Jorge M.: Noted — I'll ping legal and attach the SOW. Filing to Deal Desk now. cc @Aisha B.

Aisha B.: Thanks all. If legal signs off by EOD we can include in the term sheet for closing. :rocket:
